issues.description: The exterior sign ('ENGINEERING') is placed at y=4.5, z=7.45 where it collides with the roll-up door cylinder (y=5.2, z=7.25) and overhead hoist beam, casting a dark shadow across the top of the sign and low-contrast washed-out lettering that is barely readable in ext-1 and ext-2.
issues.fix: Move the sign above the cornice fascia or lower the roll-up shutter cylinder/hoist beam so nothing overlaps or shadows the sign face (e.g., place `k.sign({ pos: [0, 6.6, 7.25], rotY: 0, width: 6.4 })` clear of the door assembly).

issues.description: The sawtooth roof boxes use `rotY: 0` with stacked flat horizontal boxes instead of actually tilting the roof planes (`rotX`), so in ext-2, ext-3, and ext-video they read as chunky stepped rectangular blocks rather than slanted sawtooth roof slopes.
issues.fix: Use `rot: [0.32, 0, 0]` (or `rotX` if supported by `k.box`) or a stepped series of thin overlapping slabs that clearly form a 3-ridge slanted sawtooth profile, and face the clerestory windows cleanly without z-fighting.

issues.description: The east, west, and rear (north) exterior walls are completely blank brick boxes with no pilasters, windows, vents, or downpipes (visible in ext-2 and ext-video 00:01–00:06), violating DESIGN.md ('Avoid: blank flat walls, windowless boxes').
issues.fix: Continue the steel pilasters (`metal_dark`), multi-pane factory windows, and industrial details (downpipes, exhaust louver boxes) onto the east, west, and rear facades.

issues.description: In the interior (int-1, int-2, int-video), the longest floor cable tube (`points: [[6.8, 0.025, -2.2], ..., [-5.8, 0.025, -1.2]]`) bows upward in its spline interpolation and visibly floats ~10–15 cm above the central rug/floor mat, casting an obvious shadow gap.
issues.fix: Keep all intermediate spline control points at identical height `y: 0.022` with more evenly spaced points along the floor so Catmull-Rom/spline overshoot never lifts the cable into the air, and route cables around the perimeter or neatly taped down rather than floating across the main walkway.

issues.description: In int-1 and int-2, the standing `whiteboard` prop at `pos: [-3.4, 0, -6.1]` sits directly in front of the north window (`center: -3.2`), awkwardly blocking half the window frame.
issues.fix: Move the `whiteboard` to an un-windowed wall section (e.g., on the west wall between workbenches or centered on the north wall between the two windows at `x: 0, z: -6.1` if the lead workbench is shifted forward).

issues.description: The interior feels very sparse and empty (int-2, int-3), with small isolated workbenches, no chairs/stools at any workstation, no tool racks or shelving on the walls, and vast empty wood floor.
issues.fix: Add `chair_office` or stools at the workbenches, industrial shelving (`shelf_tall` or `bookshelf`) with crates/binders along the walls, a central assembly/review table or gantry, and wall-mounted conduit/tool boards to make it feel like a busy engineering workshop.

issues.description: The exterior plot around the building has only a small concrete pad and a few tiny crates/barrels right against the front wall, with no paved path to the street, street lamps, planters, or benches as required by DESIGN.md.
issues.fix: Extend the paved driveway/apron toward the front plot edge (+Z) and add industrial street lamps, planters, or bollards flanking the forecourt while keeping the 3 m entrance ring clear.

keep: Strong industrial silhouette with the tall brick-and-steel smokestack chimney and red-orange accent bands
Server rack row along the east interior wall with emissive status LED dots
Custom 3D printer enclosure with glass panels, gantry rail, and printed torus prototype in the southwest corner
All automated probes pass (probe_score: 1.0) with clean colliders and low draw calls
